Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Петр Хельчицкий» (Petr Khel'chitsky) is Petr Chelčický and «Сеть веры» (Set' very) “The Net of Faith,” as in the September and October readings; «паны» (pany) is 'lords', «холоп» (kholop) 'serf', «сословия» (sosloviya) 'estates', «поколения» (pokoleniya) 'generations', and «сброды» (sbrody) 'rabbles'. «Первосвященник» (pervosvyashchennik) is 'the high priest' and «великий священник» (velikiy svyashchennik) 'the great priest', kept distinct; the source prints «планы» (plany, 'plans') where the sense requires «паны» (pany, 'lords'), and the English gives 'lords'.

Source observation: [4] «Одни из них планы духовные, другие — светские» ('Some of them are spiritual plans, others secular'): «планы» (plany) is evidently a slip for «паны» (pany, 'lords'; Chelčický's 'spiritual and secular lords'); translated as 'lords'.
